title: Expanding the Decision Space of Pretrained Models through Structured Re-Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.15109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Native decoders limit how pretrained models combine local predictions under new structural constraints. We introduce Structured Re-Decoding (SRD), a training-free framework that constructs local candidates from model scores, samples, or external specifications, jointly optimizes their selection, and verifies reconstructed outputs. We show that candidate recombination expands feasible support and can improve attainable reward under a fixed KL divergence budget. Across molecular generation, protein design, RNA structure prediction, and antibody modeling, SRD enables improved structured inference, including verified molecules absent from the original sample pool. External chemical templates further extend SRD to noncanonical amino acids, peptide cyclization, and grammar-guided molecular construction. translated_title: 通过结构化重解码扩展预训练模型的决策空间
translated_abstract: 原生解码器限制了预训练模型在新的结构约束下组合局部预测的方式。我们提出了结构化重解码，这是一个无需训练的框架，它从模型分数、样本或外部规范构建局部候选，联合优化候选的选择，并验证重构后的输出。我们证明候选重组可以扩展可行支持集，并在固定的KL散度预算下提高可获得的奖励。在分子生成、蛋白质设计、RNA结构预测和抗体建模等任务中，SRD实现了更好的结构化推断，包括生成了原始样本池中不存在的经验证分子。外部化学模板进一步将SRD扩展到非规范氨基酸、肽环化和语法引导的分子构建。在物理相干伊辛机上的初步实验证明了基于硬件优化的可行性，暗示了更广泛的应用前景。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的结构化重解码框架SRD，通过构建和联合优化局部候选并验证重构输出，扩展预训练模型在结构化约束下的决策空间，在分子生成、蛋白质设计等任务中显著提升推断效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Structured Re-Decoding (SRD), a training-free framework that expands the decision space of pretrained models by constructing, jointly optimizing, and verifying local candidates, achieving improved structured inference across molecular generation, protein design, and related tasks.
